description: Add or remove an indicator/study on the chart

entity_id.description: Entity ID to remove (from chart_get_state). Required for remove.

indicator.description: Full indicator name: "Relative Strength Index", "MACD", "Volume", "Moving Average", "Bollinger Bands", "Moving Average Exponential". Short names like RSI/EMA do NOT work.

inputs.description: JSON string of input overrides for the indicator (e.g., '{"length": 20}')

name: chart_manage_indicator
